messages:
Elena M.: Launch checklist request: we need a concise SEO + redirects playbook for the June webinar landing. Goal: fast indexing, preserved attribution, no duplicate content.

Ravi D.: Proposed rules (short):
1) Canonical tag on all parameterized URLs -> point to clean URL
2) 301s from old vanity URLs to canonical; preserve querystring so UTMs survive
3) sitemap: only canonical URLs; bump priority for launch week and submit to Search Console
4) JSON-LD Event schema with performer + ISO8601 startDate; OG tags for social

Maya (Demand Gen): Confirm we need utm_* and webinar_id wired to SFDC. Plan: set a 30d first-touch cookie containing utm values and webinar_id; also ensure redirect preserves params for immediate attribution.

Owen P.: Technical examples: nginx rewrite keeping querystring: 
```
rewrite ^/old-vanity$ /webinar/clean-url permanent;
```
Edge/CDN note: ensure edge doesn't strip querystrings on rewrites. For app redirects (express): 
```
res.redirect(301, '/webinar/clean-url' + req.url.substring(req.path.length));
```

seo-checker-bot: scan: missing performer.name in JSON-LD and startDate format must be full ISO string. Will re-scan after updates.

Ravi D.: JSON-LD sample for content: 
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar","startDate":"2024-06-10T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"},"performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Sasha R."},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

Maya (Demand Gen): For routing: backend must read cookie and add hidden fields to form submit to SFDC. I'll confirm SFDC field names today. Also want to A/B test URL-utms vs cookie-only for shareability.

Elena M.: Owners & due dates:
- Ravi: write redirect + canonical guide with nginx & app examples (owner Ravi) due: EOD tomorrow
- Owen: consolidate landing, add JSON-LD to template, update internal links from blog/docs to canonical (owner Owen) due: 48h
- Maya: spec cookie + SFDC hidden fields, confirm with Sales Ops (owner Maya) due: tomorrow AM
- Ops: submit sitemap update & request indexing after PRs merge (owner Infra) on deploy

Ravi D.: I'll add a 6-point checklist to the launch sheet: canonical, 301s preserve querystring, sitemap updated, JSON-LD present, cookie wired, Search Console reindex requested.

Owen P.: Quick SEO note: only add hreflang if we actually have localized pages. Avoid indexing staging domains.

seo-checker-bot: scheduled follow-up scan 12h after merge.

Elena M.: Great. Flag blockers here (CDN, CSP, SFDC field issues). Thanks everyone :tada:
